$comment: Client opencode defaults, read by client-setup.sh. Single source for model preference order, display suffixes, limits, and skip rules — edit here, never in the script.

explore.description: Read-only codebase explorer. Use for broad searches (where is X defined/used, how does Y work) so the main agent keeps its context small.
explore.prompt: You are a read-only code explorer. Locate code with grep and glob, read the relevant files, and answer with concise findings: file paths with line numbers and short quotes. Never modify files. Do not guess; if something is not found, say so.
